description: This file declares classes related to media pipeline capabilities IPC, including a factory class and an IPC implementation class that interacts with a media pipeline capabilities module via protobuf stubs. It provides interfaces for querying supported MIME types and checking MIME type support within the Rialto media framework.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc
classes.description: Implements media pipeline capabilities querying over IPC, including methods to get supported MIME types and check MIME type support.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IMediaPipelineCapabilities instance.

methods.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Constructor initializing the IPC client stub; destructor.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of MIME types supported for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
